claims.claim: The Israeli Invoice Reform allocation-number threshold is 5,000 NIS / 5,000 ש"ח from June 2026 onward, measured on the amount before VAT. The step-down was 25,000 NIS / 25,000 ILS / 25,000 ש"ח in May 2024, 20,000 NIS / 20,000 ש"ח in January 2025, 10,000 NIS / 10,000 ש"ח in January 2026 and 5,000 NIS from June 2026.
claims.verification_note: The same source states the threshold amounts are computed before VAT (לפני מע"מ). No published source gives a 2027 value, so the previously listed January 2027 row was removed. The official ITA page at gov.il/he/departments/legalInfo/digital_invoice returns 403 to non-browser clients and needs a browser recheck.

claims.claim: Israel's VAT rate is 18%, in force since January 1, 2025, with no change during 2026. The outdated rate agents sometimes reach for is 17%. Arithmetic consequence used in the skill: at 18% VAT a 5,900 ILS / 5,900 ש"ח gross charge is exactly a 5,000 base.
